result.artifact:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) AS month,
    region,
    SUM(amount) AS total_sales
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY month, region
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    region,
    total_sales,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rnk
  FROM monthly_sales
)
SELECT month, region, total_sales
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 2
ORDER BY month, total_sales DESC;
